Meta.tagline: Coming soon. A marketplace built for Romania.
Meta.description: A new place to discover, connect, and transact with people you can trust.

Landing.heroTitle: Find your people for whatever selfcare means to you.
Landing.heroBody: Hair, tattoo, massage, nails and more — discover specialists near you, see how they work, and book in a few taps. Calm, considered, no pressure.
Landing.step1Body: Pick what you’re in the mood for — from a fresh cut to a deep-tissue massage.
Landing.step2Body: See specialists on a map, browse their work, read real reviews.
Landing.step3Body: Pick a time, confirm, pay. One place — no chasing DMs.
Landing.craftTitle: Specialists who care about the small things.
Landing.craftBody: Every profile on Heia is a person who shows up for their craft. You see the work before you see the price.
Landing.everyoneTitle: All self-care services. Beard, skin, hair, grooming.
Landing.everyoneBody: Wellbeing doesn’t look the same on everyone. Heia is built for all of it — every age, every gender, every kind of ritual.
Landing.featuredTitle: People worth a visit this week.
Landing.ctaTitle: Your time, your ritual. Whenever you need it.
Landing.ctaBody: Join Heia and find the people who get your vibe.
